content:
maya (PM): Draft PRD is up — slicing proposal for Chat / Embeddings / Rerank. Goal: agree launch gates and minimal acceptance criteria by EOD Wed.

maya (PM): Background: ACME wants embeddings parity + rerank support. They also asked for lower tail latency on chat for interactive experiences. We can do this in 2 phases: Phase A (must-have): API contract parity for embeddings + basic rerank endpoint + chat latency SLOs. Phase B (nice-to-have): request-level batching, dedupe embedding results, adaptive rerank thresholds.

tariq (Eng): quick read. main engineering risks: 1) rerank needs a dedicated scoring endpoint or we overload completions? 2) embeddings parity might require format / metadata changes (vector dim, model aliasing). 3) backpressure on chat with streaming + long context.

samir (ML): For parity, we need to expose model_metadata.dim and model_metadata.quantization in response. Also need stable deterministic hashing for dedupe in Phase B.

jen (SRE): Ops asks: define SLOs per route. proposed: chat p95 < 120ms for short prompts (<200 tokens), embeddings p99 < 250ms, rerank p95 < 150ms. Need targets to size Dedicated pool.

alex (Solutions): ACME will likely treat running cost as blocker. We should include a 'low-cost embed' variant (quantized) under same endpoint. Also need clear changelog for SDKs.

maya (PM): Acceptance checklist (Phase A):
- API contract documented (examples + error codes)
- SDK parity in node + python (basic CRUD)
- E2E smoke: sample app responds w/ embeddings + rerank within SLOs
- Basic telemetry: per-route latency + token-cost logging
- Canary plan + rollback criteria

maya (PM): Edge cases we identified:
- embeddings for empty or very long documents
- rerank ties (equal scores) -> deterministic fallback order
- streaming cancel mid-token -> KV cache cleanup

tariq (Eng): Noted. For rerank ties propose tie-breaker: timestamp or stable input-order. Also need to decide sync vs async rerank. Async reduces user latency but complicates consistency.

samir (ML): Async rerank: if we return partial results, need metadata: rerank_status: pending|complete and a re-fetch id. That changes API shape. prefer synchronous scoring for Phase A to avoid API churn.

maya (PM): Good call — stick sync for Phase A. Phase B explores async jobs and streaming rerank results.

alex (Solutions): SDK impact: sample call for rerank (sync):
```json
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "model": "rdrk-rerank-v1",
  "queries": ["query text"],
  "candidates": [["cand1","cand2"]]
}
```
Response: scores array aligned with candidates.

tariq (Eng): Implementation notes: minimal wire change if we add a /v1/rerank endpoint. Re-use scoring kernel from ranking service. Need ~3 dev-weeks + 1 week infra to size. Embeddings parity ~2 dev-weeks + CI work. Chat latency fixes likely iterative.

jen (SRE): Rollout plan:
- internal canary traffic 5% -> metrics check (latency, errors, token cost)
- customer pilot (ACME) with opt-in private key
- expand to GA after 1 week with no regressions
Rollback triggers: error rate > 1% absolute increase or p99 latency > baseline + 200ms.

maya (PM): Metrics we need to collect before canary: per-route p50/p95/p99, error codes, token-count distribution, cost-per-request estimate, model fallback counts.

samir (ML): Quality metrics for rerank: top-k precision with ACME evaluation set + MRR delta vs current baseline. We should define regression threshold: > 3% drop blocks GA.

alex (Solutions): ACME ask: exports for evaluation (csv of queries + candidates + labels) and an easy way to run offline rerank. Add to acceptance.

tariq (Eng): Open engineering tasks (rough):
- API contract + schema + examples (2d)
- Implement /v1/rerank (3w)
- Embeddings model metadata endpoint (1w)
- SDK updates (1w per SDK)
- Telemetry + tracing hooks (1w infra)
- Canary infra + rollout script (3d)

maya (PM): Requesting sign-offs: Eng (tariq), ML (samir), SRE (jen), Solutions (alex). Please reply with :thumbsup: if you can commit to ETA above.

tariq (Eng): :thumbsup: timeline OK, might need help from infra team for memory config.

samir (ML): :thumbsup: will provide evaluation set by Tuesday.

jen (SRE): :thumbsup: canary plan approved, will add monitors.

alex (Solutions): :thumbsup: I'll prep customer pilot docs and share legal requirements for data retention.

maya (PM): Next steps: I'll update PRD to include the acceptance criteria, edge-case list, and rollout plan. Please add any blocking items inline here — I'll tag for follow-up in the roadmap sync.

deploy-bot: Created PR: "specs/rerank-embed-slice" — review requested by @tariq, @samir.

maya (PM): Thanks all. If no objections, we'll lock scope for Phase A tomorrow morning and ship timeline to stakeholders. :rocket:
